_comment: What OLOS publishes to the team knowledge repository (TheUpskillingLabs/Docs-repository) and how. Design: docs/roadmap/documentation-topology.md. `knowledgeRepo` is the default; the workflow's KNOWLEDGE_REPO repository variable overrides it. modes: mirror = copy on every merge to dev, keep in OLOS · mirror+prune = copy, then the monthly sweep PR removes it from OLOS once the knowledge repo holds the same content · snapshot = copy on each release tag as a dated file. `folders` supplies the meta-documentation: the publisher writes a README.md in each listed folder (title, relevance, file table with provenance; the folder's own OLOS README, if published, is embedded below the table). Files are rewritten only when their content changed. `neverPublish` is documentation of intent: the publisher only ever reads paths listed in `rules`.

olos/.title: OLOS — published from the code repository
olos/.relevance: Everything under this folder is generated from TheUpskillingLabs/OLOS by the publish-artifacts workflow. It is the team-facing copy of the plan, the decisions, the reference docs, and the artifacts of completed work. Edit in OLOS by pull request; never here.

olos/roadmap/.title: Roadmap — the plan of record
olos/roadmap/.relevance: The current phase's audit, sprint plan, personas, documentation contract, data strategy, and curriculum brief. Read `next-sprint.md` for what is happening now and `README.md` for the reading order. This is the alignment layer: deadlines, workstreams, and owner decisions live here.

olos/decisions/.title: Decisions — the vault
olos/decisions/.relevance: Decision records (ADRs), spec divergences, and workflows from `docs/vault/` in OLOS (PR #391). Why the build is the way it is. A decision that stops holding is superseded, never deleted.

olos/reference/.title: Reference — how OLOS is shaped
olos/reference/.relevance: The explanation docs an engineer or agent reads before touching an area: architecture, the sector/lab/org models, the sensemaking flow, the Ortelius north star, and the May 2026 state-machine postmortem. Current unless the status header says otherwise.

olos/requirements/.title: Requirements — design docs for buildable slices
olos/requirements/.relevance: Requirement and design documents for work in flight or recently shipped (cycle timeline, pod registration, permissions, moderator insights). Check each file's status header; several are re-baselines of June drafts.

olos/audits/2026-07/.title: Audits — July 2026 (prototype → OLOS)
olos/audits/2026-07/.relevance: The point-in-time audit set from 2026-07-04/07: design intent, gap audit, data architecture principles, the Phase 0–7 improvement roadmap, its progress snapshot, and the social-layer analysis. Superseded as the plan by `../../roadmap/2026-09-audit.md`; `DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md` §2 remains the data constitution.

olos/feedback/.title: Feedback — the running intake log
olos/feedback/.relevance: Hands-on testing feedback about the app, triaged against code (✅ addressed · 🧭 needs a product call). Append in OLOS; read here.

olos/sessions/.title: Sessions — the artifacts of completed work
olos/sessions/.relevance: One report per substantive work session (Claude Code, pairing, work day): what was asked, done, verified, decided, and left open. Chronological by filename. This is the trail of what was completed and when.

olos/archive/.title: Archive — finished and superseded
olos/archive/.relevance: Session artifacts, historical PRDs, design specs, and superseded plans. Accurate on their date; kept for provenance. Nothing here is current guidance.

olos/schema/.title: Schema — the database, readable
olos/schema/.relevance: `SCHEMA.md` (ERDs + table summary, generated from the migrations) and a dated snapshot per release tag under `snapshots/`, so the shape of the database at any promotion can be compared.

olos/releases/.title: Releases — what shipped at each promotion
olos/releases/.relevance: One changelog section per `dev → main` promotion, named by CalVer tag. The Ops group in each lists the migrations applied to production.

program/marketing-site-corpus/.title: Marketing-site corpus
program/marketing-site-corpus/.relevance: The legacy Squarespace export (2026-07-06 snapshot), kept as a copy source for public pages and FAQs. Not final copy.

program/work-days/.title: Work days — sprints and hackathons
program/work-days/.relevance: Retros and proto-requirements from the in-person Sensemaking Sprint and Hackathon, plus hand-written run-of-shows. The physical prototype of what OLOS digitizes.

olos/audits/.title: Audits — point-in-time
olos/audits/.relevance: One dated folder per audit set. An audit is never edited after its date; a newer audit supersedes it. The September 2026 audit lives in `../roadmap/2026-09-audit.md` because it is part of the current plan.
